args.query: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table';

CREATE TABLE cohort_summary AS
SELECT cohort, COUNT(participant_id) AS cohort_size, 
       (SELECT contact_notes FROM participants WHERE participants.cohort = cohort LIMIT 1) AS example_comment
FROM participants
GROUP BY cohort;

UPDATE cohort_summary
SET example_comment = (
    SELECT contact_notes
    FROM participants p
    WHERE p.cohort = cohort_summary.cohort
    LIMIT 1
);
